title: Revise Warrant spec around agreed product shape and obtain Fable review
description: Trey approved the proposed next step on 2026-09-17: revise the spec and provide a plain-language change summary, obtain Fable review, and surface remaining human decisions. Preserve useful reuse; remove all task/planning/project management; make the first Atlas experience central; strengthen evidence and authority contracts. No implementation or build-plan authorization. The draft remains unratified until Trey, Astra, and Fable agree.
notes: Draft 0.3 integrated from Astra/Fable co-design review; final consistency review of the exact candidate remains required. Trey ruled R14 early no-benefit checkpoint, R15 two active approval kinds, R16 preferences advise by default. Main changes: actual before-decision delivery, S7 retrieval qualification, manifest-free census, exact exception batches, source comparison semantics, preserved execution identities, simpler trust administration. Ten JSON/thirteen YAML syntax examples, numbered references, retired-surface and privacy/whitespace checks pass; README/summary prose scans clean, spec retains two JSON-fence false positives. No runtime, signing, model, experiment, or infrastructure work.
close_reason: Astra and Fable agree on exact spec draft 0.3 at 7b30330 after independent review, integration, and final corrections. See docs/specs/2026-09-17-warrant-v0.3-changes.md and docs/plans/live-state.md. All material review findings are addressed; ratification remains warrant-wmz, with no plan/build authorization.

title: Review v1 spec against the product vision
description: Trey requested Astra's first assessment of the current spec: what serves the vision, what is missing, and what should change, be added, or be removed. Review only; no ratification, implementation, or spec edits.
notes: First review recommends revision before ratification. Product: move context/propose and a minimal census into the first useful slice; run semantic feasibility work before dependent effect/capability promises; make enforcement limits machine-checkable; measure repeated task outcomes and human burden. Acceptance: specify protected gate execution and runner provenance; test the exact materialized candidate; default to fresh integrated evidence rather than import-closure carry-over. Policy: distinguish canonical rules from snapshot-instantiated obligations; compare prospective permissions, not only current obligation sets; anchor approved policy outside candidate discretion. Contradictions: judgment review blocks acceptance despite D3 wording; gate principal arrangement conflicts with trust assumptions; tree IDs do not establish ancestry; draft narrowing ratification is ambiguous. Supporting source sections: 3.7, 6.5, 7.4-7.6, 9.1-9.2, 10.1, 11.1-11.7, 12.3-12.4, 13.3-13.4, 16.4, 17.5, 19.6, 20.2, 21. Findings are specification-level, not tested vulnerabilities. Spec and ratification bead unchanged.
close_reason: First vision-led assessment completed for Trey; recommendations recorded in review notes and docs/plans/live-state.md. Spec unchanged; ratification remains open. Verification: full spec and vision read, source claims cross-checked against named sections, prose review, git diff --check. No implementation exists to test.
